ocl.definition: card:BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o | o.CardID = cardid), exists:Boolean = if card.oclIsUndefined() then false else true endif
ocl.postcondition: let newCard:BankCard in newCard.oclIsNew(), BankCard.allInstance()->includes(newCard) and result = exists and (exists = false implies (newCard.CardID = cardid and newCard.CardStatus = cardstatus and newCard.Catalog = catalog and newCard.Password = password and newCard.Balance = balance))

contractErrors.msg: mismatched input 'exists' expecting {'*', 'self', 'result', 'Tuple', 'true', 'false', 'null', 'invalid', 'Set', 'Bag', 'Sequence', 'Collection', 'OrderedSet', RULE_DOUBLE_QUOTED_STRING, RULE_SINGLE_QUOTED_STRING, RULE_ID, RULE_INT}
